title: My Mother and My Uncle
text:
My mother is a nurse. She works in a small hospital in our town. She helps doctors and sick people. She starts work early in the morning.

My uncle Peter is a driver. He drives a big bus to the city. He works from Monday to Friday. He likes his job because he meets many people.

questions.text: How does the uncle probably feel about his job?
options: He is always tired of it

questions.text: What can we say about the mother and the uncle?
options: They both work at a school

vocabulary.definition: a person whose job is to care for sick people
a place where doctors treat sick people
a person who drives a vehicle as their job
the work a person does to earn money

paragraph_translations: Моя мама — медсестра. Вона працює в маленькій лікарні в нашому місті. Вона допомагає лікарям і хворим людям. Вона починає роботу рано вранці.
Мій дядько Петро — водій. Він водить великий автобус до міста. Він працює з понеділка до п'ятниці. Йому подобається його робота, бо він зустрічає багато людей.
